data:
In fiscal 2023 (the year ended June 30, 2023), Microsoft reported revenue of **$211.9 billion** ($211,915 million), gross profit (labeled "gross margin" in the filing) of **$146.1 billion** ($146,052 million) and operating income of **$88.5 billion** ($88,523 million). That gives a **gross margin of about 68.9%** and an **operating margin of about 41.8%**.

For comparison, in fiscal 2022 revenue was $198.3 billion, gross profit was $135.6 billion (about 68.4%) and operating income was $83.4 billion (about 42.1%). So in fiscal 2023 gross margin rose slightly while operating margin fell slightly. The main reason was higher operating expenses, especially general and administrative costs, which rose from $5.9 billion to $7.6 billion.
